name: Hybrid AD, Passwords Still Required
description: On-premises Active Directory in play; the customer cannot go fully passwordless yet. Passwords and SSPR remain in scope, so SSPR hygiene matters more here; a gradual move off legacy MFA methods is acceptable rather than an immediate hard requirement.

SSPR001.Note: Passwords remain the norm for this tenant, so SSPR registration hygiene carries more weight than it would for a passwordless-only customer.

AUTH002.Note: Still migrating off AD-era MFA; SMS may coexist with stronger methods for a defined transition period rather than being an immediate blocker.

STR001.Note: Phishing-resistant strength rollout can be gradual while the tenant is still migrating off on-prem AD passwords.
